title: Memory reorg - migrate the oldest memory entries into docs/ and .claude/rules/
description:
Fabio, 2026-08-10: reorganise agent memory, taking the OLDEST entries first and moving durable knowledge out of memory into docs/ and .claude/rules/, per the repo law that a fact about the codebase lives in a subsystem doc, never in memory. Memory keeps only who Fabio is, how I should work, in-flight state, cross-project strategy, and how to drive the environment.

Scope: the pre-2026-08 files. Each one is either (a) migrated into the right doc/rule then deleted, (b) already covered by a doc/sibling-repo README and deleted as a duplicate, or (c) kept because it is process/environment knowledge with no docs home. Backlinks in the surviving memory files and the MEMORY.md / feedback-index.md / procedures-index.md indexes are healed in the same pass, and every migrated fact is verified against the current code before it is written into a doc.
